data.text: Luke, you’re new here, but you deserve the same share as anyone who grew up fishing this lake—not less, and not the whole lake. I’m ready to commit to 10 tons alongside the others. That leaves the breeding stock we all need. What concerns me is that monthly disclosure comes too late to undo an emptied lake. Could we agree now to fish together and check our catches as we go, stopping at 10 tons each? That gives everyone a way to see the agreement being honored. Would that assurance change your mind?
